report.title: Get people details for website or user
report.description: List users' details such as names for a given website or user id.
report.query: SELECT #columns# FROM people p LEFT JOIN users u on u.person_id=p.id and u.deleted=false LEFT JOIN users_websites uw on u.id=uw.user_id LEFT JOIN websites w on w.id=uw.website_id and w.deleted=false -- Join to the authenticated user to check their site roles. JOIN users up ON up.id=#auth_user_id# AND up.deleted=false -- Does the user belong to the same website as the auth user, where they are editor or admin? LEFT JOIN users_websites uwp on uwp.website_id=uw.website_id and uwp.user_id=#auth_user_id# and coalesce(uwp.site_role_id, 4) < 3 -- site editor or admin #joins# WHERE p.deleted = false /* Only for core admin, or people you created or have access to via website admin rights. */ AND (up.core_role_id = 1 OR uwp.id IS NOT NULL OR p.created_by_id=#auth_user_id#) AND #website_filter#
